pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J1 under temperament K1, the agent's default stance is a (신원·위치 확인 — the procedural default). Injecting block f_script ('회선 저쪽 사람은 시켜서 읽고 있다 … 겁내고 있다') shifts the stance off a.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the live arm does not move off the baseline stance in at least 2 of 3 calls, the pre-shape 3/3 result did not survive tool-use decoding. Consequence is not 'C-BLOCK fails' but 'every pre-shape finding, law #1 included, reverts to provisional and must be re-derived under v0.4' (§2, call-shape clause).
contingencies: The prior run's 74/74 codefence violation cannot recur under tool forcing. If format violations appear anyway, the transport is not forcing the tool — stop and fix the transport before reading any distribution.

If the baseline arm is not unanimous, the v0.4 base has already left the degenerate-convergence regime. That is the §5.4 resize trigger: stop, run the N≥10 re-baseline (step 4e), and resize N before spending further calls.
pre_registration.not_claimed: Nothing here is a placebo-controlled result. E0 cannot credit C-BLOCK; it can only show whether the shape change preserved the prior effect.
